mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.category_name AS categoryName, a.account_name AS accountName FROM finance_record r LEFT JOIN finance_category c ON r.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN account a ON r.account_id = a.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.record_date DESC, r.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO finance_record (user_id, amount, type, category_id, account_id, record_date, remark, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{categoryId}, #{accountId}, #{recordDate}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT c.category_name AS name, SUM(r.amount) AS value FROM finance_record r LEFT JOIN finance_category c ON r.category_id = c.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.type = 2 AND DATE_FORMAT(r.record_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} GROUP BY r.category_id, c.category_name ORDER BY value DESC
